doc.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023

title: Ria's EP and CD release plans
summary: They discuss Ria's EP, CDs, a May 19th release party at Caffe Lena, and his own Bandcamp records.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: What will you do product-wise when you finish the recording with Ria?
Well we’re doing — she’s going to do an EP and then it’ll be downloadable, but we’re going to make CDs also even though I don’t know where that’s at these days.
I know but you almost, it just feels like you should.

You know what I mean? You know? I want the thing. I love this you know, oh man this was great, but at least a CD and oh man, it’s just something you can pick up. And sell a lot of them on gigs you know so that’s like, so we’re doing a CD release party on May 19th at Caffe Lena for her. And you know she’s doing it in a more music-industry way. She’s going to release singles. That’s the thing you do. You do a promo thing, you do push, you release a single this month and next month and that’s a whole different world for me. Usually it’s like this record I did with Harvey Sorgen and Jay Anderson, you know you go in you play, you record it and you put it out on BandCamp and then off to the next. You know all that. I’m sure you’ve been down those avenues.
